contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ GLOR IAEXERC ITVS

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IAEXERC ITVS. In exergue: PLG, probably first officina at Lyons mint. Diameter: 16.7mm, Weight: 2.08gms, die axis: 12
